title: Analysis of the Efficacy and Mechanism of Action of Xuebijing Injection on ARDS Using Meta-Analysis and Network Pharmacology.
authors: Zhang, Yun; Wang, Jie; Liu, Yong-Mei; Yang, Hui; Wu, Guang-Jun; He, Xuan-Hui
one_liner_zh: 该文通过Meta分析和网络药理学研究血必净注射液对ARDS的疗效与机制，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is defined as the acute onset of noncardiogenic edema and subsequent gas-exchange impairment due to a severe inflammatory process known as cytokine storm. Xuebijing injection (hereinafter referred to as Xuebijing) is a patent drug that was used to treat ARDS or severe pneumonia (SP) in China. However, its efficacy and mechanism of actions remain unclear. In this study, we used meta-analysis and network pharmacology to assess these traits of Xuebijing. METHODS: We searched PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), and Wanfang databases for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that evaluated Xuebijing therapy for ARDS or SP. The outcomes were total mortality, intensive care unit (ICU) stay time, and TNF-alpha and IL-6 levels. We performed a meta-analysis using RevMan 5.3 software. The putative targets, top 10 proteins, and possible pathway of Xuebinjing on ARDS were analyzed by network pharmacology. TNF-alpha and IL-6 were further docked with the six main active components of Xuebinjing using AutoDock 4.2.6 and PyMol 1.5.0.3 software. RESULTS: Fifteen RCTs involving 2778 patients (13 ARDS and 2 SP) were included. Compared with the control, Xuebijing treatment significantly reduced the mortality rate (risk ratio, 0.64 (95% credible interval (CrI), 0.54-0.77)), reduced the ICU stay time (mean difference (MD), -4.51 (95% CrI, -4.97--4.06)), reduced the TNF-alpha ((MD), -1.23 (95% CrI, -1.38--1.08)) and IL-6 ((MD), -1.15 (95% CrI, -1.52--0.78)) levels. The 56 putative targets, top 10 proteins (MAPK1 (mitogen-activated protein kinase 1), MAPK8 (mitogen-activated protein kinase 8), RELA (transcription factor p65), NFKB1 (nuclear factor NF-kappa-B p105 subunit), JUN (transcription factor AP-1), SRC (proto-oncogene tyrosine-protein kinase), TNF (tumor necrosis factor), HRAS (GTPase HRas), IL6 (interleukin-6), and APP (amyloid-beta A4 protein)), and possible pathways (Ret tyrosine kinase, IL2-mediated signaling events, CD4+/CD8+ T cell-related TCR signaling, p75(NTR)-mediated signaling, CXCR4-mediated signaling events, LPA receptor-mediated events, IL12-mediated signaling events, FAS (CD95) signaling pathway, and immune system) of Xuebinjing's action on ARDS were obtained. The molecular docking results showed that all the six components of Xuebinjing docked with TNF-alpha, and two components docked with IL-6 got the binding energies lower than -5. CONCLUSION: Our results recommended Xuebijing treatment for patients with ARDS. Xuebijing has therapeutic effects on ARDS patients partly by regulating the immune cell/cytokine pathways and thus inhibiting the cytokine storm. TNF-alpha is the cytokine both directly and indirectly inhibited by Xuebijing, and IL-6 is the cytokine mainly indirectly inhibited by Xuebijing.
abstract_zh: 目的：急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）被定义为由严重炎症过程（即细胞因子风暴）引起的非心源性水肿及随后气体交换障碍的急性发作。血必净注射液（以下简称血必净）是中国用于治疗ARDS或重症肺炎（SP）的专利药物。然而，其疗效和作用机制仍不清楚。本研究采用荟萃分析和网络药理学方法评估血必净的这些特性。方法：我们检索了PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library、中国知网（CNKI）和万方数据库，以获取评估血必净治疗ARDS或SP的随机对照试验（RCTs）。结局指标包括总死亡率、重症监护病房（ICU）住院时间以及TNF-α和IL-6水平。我们使用RevMan 5.3软件进行荟萃分析。通过网络药理学分析血必净对ARDS的推定靶点、前10个蛋白质及可能通路。进一步使用AutoDock 4.2.6和PyMol 1.5.0.3软件将TNF-α和IL-6与血必净的六种主要活性成分进行分子对接。结果：共纳入15项随机对照试验，涉及2778名患者（13项ARDS和2项SP）。与对照组相比，血必净治疗显著降低了死亡率（风险比，0.64（95%可信区间（CrI），0.54-0.77）），缩短了ICU住院时间（均数差（MD），-4.51（95% CrI，-4.97--4.06）），降低了TNF-α（（MD），-1.23（95% CrI，-1.38--1.08））和IL-6（（MD），-1.15（95% CrI，-1.52--0.78））水平。获得了血必净作用于ARDS的56个推定靶点、前10个蛋白质（MAPK1（丝裂原活化蛋白激酶1）、MAPK8（丝裂原活化蛋白激酶8）、RELA（转录因子p65）、NFKB1（核因子NF-κB p105亚基）、JUN（转录因子AP-1）、SRC（原癌基因酪氨酸蛋白激酶）、TNF（肿瘤坏死因子）、HRAS（GTP酶HRas）、IL6（白细胞介素-6）和APP（淀粉样β A4蛋白））以及可能通路（Ret酪氨酸激酶、IL2介导的信号事件、CD4+/CD8+ T细胞相关TCR信号、p75(NTR)介导的信号、CXCR4介导的信号事件、LPA受体介导的事件、IL12介导的信号事件、FAS（CD95）信号通路和免疫系统）。分子对接结果显示，血必净的六种成分均与TNF-α对接，其中两种成分与IL-6对接的结合能低于-5。结论：我们的结果推荐血必净治疗用于ARDS患者。血必净对ARDS患者具有治疗作用，部分通过调节免疫细胞/细胞因子通路从而抑制细胞因子风暴实现。TNF-α是血必净直接和间接抑制的细胞因子，而IL-6主要是血必净间接抑制的细胞因子。
